pages.title: A loud click · 1/3
paragraphs: It is seven in the morning in an old building in Boston. Gui takes out the trash in his pajamas. Behind him, the door closes with a loud click. He checks his pockets: no keys. He feels a little nervous and embarrassed. He walks down to find the building manager.
“Excuse me, Sal! I’m locked out of my apartment.” says Sal. “Oh no! Did you lose your key?” says Sal. “No. I left my key inside, on the table.” says Sal.
